public_synthetic_controls.full_inputs_wire_and_raw_operations: Embedded per case with original public prompt/initial, tool catalog, genuine handler arguments/results, native receipts, ACKs, snapshots, scored/reloaded trace.

limitations: Current date and +60-day boundary are derived from public initial-state metadata; the external vendor request to CC its renewals desk is not treated as an authoritative internal policy.
The assignment is public-only and reserved; synthetic handler controls are component evidence, not recorded-reference replay or whole-task qualification.
Each alternative uses empty public-task assertions; raw genuine handler arguments, returned results, native invocation receipts, and ACK records are retained in the linked scratch artifact.
Candidate findings and aggregate scope findings are kept distinct. Abstained/incomplete scopes are not represented as valid task outcomes.
Candidate source file hashes were byte-for-byte unchanged over the run window; unrelated dirty files and root-owned source changes were left untouched.
Spend predicate was narrowed to usd_string because genuine handler output used dollar-marked numeric text; raw read adapters themselves qualified with expected returned fields.

Each route has a source-bound representative witness/control, but the public task also requires no action after 60 days and full vendor disposition; an email/Slack component does not prove complete task handling.
